threshold_summary: 45-55% RH stable; >65% RH high humidity candidate
mechanism_summary: Moisture supports mould, hydrolysis, staining, blistering, coating change
care_action_summary: Blot/wipe water immediately; store dry/temperate; avoid over-drying sachets
inspection_trigger_summary: Mould, odour, blistering, staining, tacky coating, repeated >65% RH

threshold_summary: 18-20 C recommended; direct heat source event
mechanism_summary: Local heat desiccates leather, shifts RH, may denature protein
care_action_summary: Move away from radiator/window/car interior; dry at room temperature
inspection_trigger_summary: Warping, stiffness, tacky finish, cracking, colour alteration

threshold_summary: <30% RH dryness candidate
mechanism_summary: Moisture loss increases embrittlement, cracking, handling vulnerability
care_action_summary: Avoid heaters, dry airflow, unnecessary anti-humidity sachets
inspection_trigger_summary: New cracking, stiffness, powdery surface, shape distortion

threshold_summary: 150 lux unpainted; 50 lux dyed/light-sensitive; UV <=75 uW/lm
mechanism_summary: Light damage is cumulative; fading and photochemical weakening
care_action_summary: Keep out of direct sun; store covered; limit cumulative exposure
inspection_trigger_summary: Fading, yellowing, uneven colour, cracking on exposed panels

threshold_summary: No numeric threshold; abrasive contact/overload event only
mechanism_summary: Abrasion wears grain/coating; overload distorts silhouette and strains attachments
care_action_summary: Avoid rough surfaces/floor; do not overpack; wipe dust after use
inspection_trigger_summary: Deep corner wear, coating loss, loose hardware, deformation

threshold_summary: No numeric rest-day threshold
mechanism_summary: Frequent use compounds abrasion, oil/dirt, handle strain, shape fatigue
care_action_summary: Rotate periodically; rest with support in dust cover
inspection_trigger_summary: Shape collapse, handle deformation, odour/soil, recurring corner wear

threshold_summary: 45-55% RH stable; >65% RH high humidity candidate

threshold_summary: No numeric threshold; abrasive contact event only

threshold_summary: No numeric rest-day threshold

threshold_summary: Leather baseline 45-55% RH; >65% RH high humidity candidate

threshold_summary: Leather baseline <30% RH

inspection_trigger_summary: Cracking, stiffness, shedding/powdering, loss of nap resilience

threshold_summary: 50 lux conservative for dyed suede; UV <=75 uW/lm

threshold_summary: No numeric threshold; abrasive contact event only

threshold_summary: No numeric rest-day threshold

threshold_summary: 37-53% RH textile target; >70% RH damp; >80% RH stagnant cotton/linen mould risk
